policy.source_scope: Previously consumed project sources only; no fresh accuracy claim.
policy.fit: 120 v11 source groups (specialist_cal and fusion_fit); exact source RGB masks, original/lighting/jpeg55 variants and genuine ordinary-patch controls.
policy.point: 60 source-disjoint v11 fusion_cal groups; at most5% genuine groups with original or ordinary-patch response strictly above point; no AI outcomes used.
policy.diagnostic: 60 v11 confirmation plus48 consumed v12 groups; no role changes or case omission.
policy.projection: Remove top2 fit-genuine standardized intervention-delta covariance directions. Same augmented fit samples, L2=.01, logistic ranking head in both arms.
policy.localization: Source-resolution measurements pooled to64x64. Median3x3 response,8-connected components with>=16 cells. Edge-aligned source coordinate projection.
policy.limits: No pretrained weights or neural forwards. No confidence calibration, full-image authorship, fresh-source, unseen-generator, external reviewer or serving admission claim.
policy.continuation: Require higher mean edited IoU and more IoU>=.3 cases than current, no extra genuine flags, and ordinary-control flags<=5%; passing needs real baseline ordinary controls and fresh confirmation before any promotion.
